name: Opening Act
summary: Gives each listener a Regular Enhancement Slot: "Voice Radius - Charm - Grant Enhancement Slot".

name: Restful Lullaby
summary: After at least 4 hours of sleep, listeners recover all Life Points and gain +1 level in one skill of their choice; once per person per re-pop. "Voice Radius - Charm - Restful Lullaby".

name: Performance of Courage
summary: Gives one Resist Fear (E): "Voice Radius - Charm - Grant Resist Fear".

name: Performance of Shared Vision
summary: The results of one chosen person's next 3 divinations this encounter show in illusory color for all present. Aimed at a Safe Hearth, it lasts on that area until disenchanted or re-pop and lets Manifested Spirits there talk normally (update the Safe Hearth Notes).

name: Performance of Forgotten Knowledge
summary: Clears Knowledge enhancements from listeners' slots so the slots can be reused: "Voice Radius - Charm - Remove Knowledge Enhancements".

name: Performance of Anger
summary: Gives one use of Aggression (E): "Voice Radius - Charm - Grant Aggression".

name: Performance of Restoration
summary: Heals 50 Life Points: "Voice Radius - Charm - Heal 50 Life".

name: Performance of Shrouding
summary: While you keep performing, the area is shielded from most scrying: "Voice Radius - Charm - Shroud Scrying". Aimed at a Safe Hearth, it lasts there until disenchanted or re-pop (update the Safe Hearth Notes).

name: Performance of Speed
summary: Gives one use of Blink (E): "Voice Radius - Charm - Grant Blink".

name: Performance of Mana
summary: Renews one use of a Basic Magic skill: "Voice Radius - Charm - Renew One Use of a Basic Magic Skill".

name: Performance of Mental Endurance
summary: Gives one Resist Charm or Resist Sleep (E); using it also makes the user immune to that effect for the encounter. "Voice Radius - Charm - Mental Endurance".

name: Performance of Crafting
summary: Listeners regain one crafting skill use. Call: "Voice Radius - Charm - Renew One Use of a Crafting Skill".

name: Performance of Meditative Comfort
summary: Listeners may rest and meditate 10 minutes to renew one skill use spent in their last encounter. Aimed at a Safe Hearth, it lasts there until disenchanted or re-pop, usable once per person after each encounter (update the Safe Hearth Notes).

name: Performance of Renewed Knowledge
summary: Renews all used Knowledge-granted skill uses in one enhancement slot per target: "Voice Radius - Charm - Renew Knowledge Enhancement".

name: Performance of Battle
summary: Gives +1 Passive Weapon and Relic damage for the next encounter (E): "Voice Radius - Charm - Grant +1 Passive Damage for the Next Encounter".

name: Performance of Inspiration
summary: Listeners regain one use of any skill. Call: "Voice Radius - Charm - Renew One Use of a Skill".

name: Performance of Purification
summary: Removes one named status effect: "Voice Radius - Charm - Remove <Status Effect>".

name: Performance of Safe Hearth
summary: The building becomes a Safe Hearth: healing counts act as if Amplify Healing applied, poison and bleed out counts pause, diseases are suppressed, and hostile portals or dimensional travel are blocked. Write a Safe Hearth Notes sheet afterwards.
